component.name: Amber
component.summary: Play local MP3, FLAC and WebM files

description.p: A small music player for local files. Every folder is an album, lyrics from .lrc files or tags are drawn over the blurred cover and follow playback, and the player can be controlled through MPRIS, for example with playerctl or the desktop's media keys.
Rewritten with GTK 4 and libadwaita; MPRIS support.
